Senior Research Fellow (SRF): M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, or a related discipline, preferably with specialization in Power Systems, Power Electronics, Control Systems, or related areas, with First Division as defined by the awarding Institute/University, along with preferably two (02) years of relevant research/professional experience.

content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, or a related discipline, preferably with specialization in Power Systems, Power Electronics, Control Systems, or related areas, with First Division as defined by the awarding Institute/University. Senior Research Fellow (SRF): M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, or a related discipline, preferably with specialization in Power Systems, Power Electronics, Control Systems, or related areas, with First Division as defined by the awarding Institute/University, along with preferably two (02) years of relevant research/professional experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Ropar Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 18-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Ropar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Senior Research Fellow (SRF) posts is 18th September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for JRF and SRF posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies. Out of these, 4 vacancies are for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position and 3 vacancies are for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required is M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or an equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, or a related discipline, with First Division.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post?
faq.answer: Yes, for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position, candidates should preferably have two years of relevant research or professional experience in addition to the educational qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these positions?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or use the provided link to submit their applications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF/SRF posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by a further selection process for those who are shortlisted. Specific details will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for IIT Ropar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It is recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Senior Research Fellow (SRF) at IIT Ropar are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of IIT Ropar?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Ropar is located in Rupnagar, Punjab.
